subject.title: feat(android): tap-to-expand link previews in chat transcript

question: Should Android ship tap-to-expand client-side link previews that fetch the linked page only after a user tap, once the image-only bug and real-proof gap are fixed?
rationale: This PR adds a new network and privacy surface in chat, so even with good mitigations the final product/security posture needs maintainer intent rather than an automated merge-only decision.

options.title: Proceed after repair and proof
options.body: Fix the image-only empty card, add real Android behavior proof, and then treat the tap-only text-preview design as the intended product path.

options.title: Pause for link-preview policy
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers define the cross-platform policy for URL preview fetching, images, and security review.

options.title: Defer to the polish tracker
options.body: Leave the broader mobile polish issue as the planning item and postpone Android link previews until the other chat polish slices are scoped.

recommendation.title: Proceed after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Fix the image-only empty card, add real Android behavior proof, and then treat the tap-only text-preview design as the intended product path.
